title: Six-seed realization diversity on one long dialogue case
purpose: Produce six real raw generations from the SAME frozen settled input and decide whether they are genuinely different realizations before any best-of-N wiring. This batch is a diversity pilot; it does not by itself establish a best-of-N benefit.

sharedPack.note: Public development regression material, never a final holdout. Hashes are pinned; a changed package fails preparation instead of silently mixing versions.

model.family: Qwen2.5 instruct base (lane-10 training docstring); the runner records the actual config and weight hashes, which are authoritative
model.quantization: none (transformers safetensors, bfloat16 if the node supports it, float16 otherwise)
model.why: Already on HPC (lane-10 base for the qwen15b training arms), no new download and no local 4060 use.
model.notTheProductWeights: This is NOT the current browser product checkpoint. This batch studies base-model sampling diversity; any product claim requires a same-condition re-run on the actual browser weights.

template.system: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
template.note: The shared pack input already is the 视角/上回合状态/本回合变化/本回合状态 view; the user turn is the trained instruct shape. requiredFacts/notes/reference are never in the prompt.

sampling.note: temperature/top-p/top-k and the token cap follow the product candidate defaults (06 passes temperature 0.45 and maxTokens 240); repetition_penalty/no_repeat_ngram stay neutral so the measurement is not padded.

resource.device: one HPC GPU (prefer RTX 4090; V100 fp16 fallback)
